title: Command Center launch approval record, contract 2.0 (canonical, after normalization)
description: Minted only by Command Center from the client's own reply carrying the plan-hash prefix. An AI session cannot write it, so a file shaped like this is never an approval. This schema describes the CANONICAL record approval_record.normalize_record() produces; the raw Command Center wire row it is normalized FROM is described in $defs.command_center_wire, and the previous shared shape in $defs.shared_v1. Normalization is an explicit enumerated mapping (approval_record.LEGACY_KIND_ALIASES); a record it does not name is refused, never guessed.

kind.description: Canonical kind. This is the only meaning the verifier acts on. No kind implies another (approval_record.IMPLIED_KINDS is empty for every kind).

kind_wire.description: The kind spelling as it arrived (e.g. Command Center's plan_build / publish). Kept for audit; never used for authorization.

plan_hash.description: Bare lowercase SHA-256 hex digest, with any sha256: prefix stripped.

tenant_ref.description: The COMPANY/tenant routing identity (Command Center tenant_id). NOT the consenting person. Null on a legacy record that cannot distinguish the two.

consenting_actor_ref.description: The authenticated PERSON who approved (Command Center client_identity_ref). This is the only field that may be described as the approver.

scope.description: Normalized scope list. A Command Center single-string scope is split on commas and the whole string is kept as a member.

authority.description: Derived from the transport that produced the record, never read from the record body. A local file cannot declare itself authenticated.

command_center_wire.title: launch-approvals.ts row as the Command Center GET returns it
command_center_wire.description: Observed shape of src/lib/launch-approvals.ts at audit anchor b1f3b64b2. Listed so the mapping is documented where the schema lives. This is an INPUT shape: it is never itself a canonical record.

revoked.description: 0/1 in the SQLite row; boolean on the wire

shared_v1.title: The previous shared record shape (schema_version 1.0)
shared_v1.description: Still accepted. client_identity is read as the consenting actor and the result is marked identity_binding='legacy_unclassified' because this shape cannot say whether the value is a person or a company.
